messages:
mia (product): Planning a staggered cohort release for the EU Dedicated runway feature. Idea: "degrade ladder" instead of binary fallbacks so customers see gradual quality steps. Preference: preserve latency SLAs first, then cost.
tera (eng-sre): Agree. Define ladder steps and triggers. Suggest steps: 1) reduce burst cap, 2) enable prefix-caching, 3) swap to quantized variant, 4) smaller-model degrade. Trigger: sustained 10m over budget or p95 increase.
jules (eng-platform): Implementation: rollout by cohorts (internal -> 1% -> 5% -> 20%). Each cohort gets a telemetry gate: must show <5% QoR regression vs baseline before next stage. We'll add feature_flag.degrade_ladder and per-tenant ladder_level.
evan (eng-runtime): Runtime notes: can apply ladder transitions atomically per-tenant. Need idempotent API: set_ladder_level(tenant, level, reason). Also need a dry-run mode to simulate decision without routing change.
sam (sales): From customers: they'd prefer a visible "quality impact" note and an option to opt into being downgraded for cost savings. We should prepare templated tradeoff language and a temporary SLA-credit model if we enforce downgrade.
ops-oncall: Ops: circuit breakers are required. Proposal: if error rate >1% OR p95 latency worsens by >200ms for 5m after a ladder change, auto-revert that tenant and page. Also add a cooldown and an audit log entry.
mia (product): Launch criteria draft: API + dry-run, console ladder UI, telemetry gates + canary cohort, legal signoff for any cross-border option, customer templates. Soft launch to 10% of EU Dedicated after canary pass.
jules (eng-platform): Telemetry: ladder_event, tenant_id, from_level, to_level, trigger_metric, pre_metrics, post_metrics. Retain 45d; sample full traces 2% of events.
evan (eng-runtime): Engineering constraint: pushing per-tenant ladder changes at scale must be batched. We'll canary the flag push to internal tenants first. Also need migration script for tenants with pre-existing custom routing.
tera (eng-sre): Preflight tests: mixed-load spike sim with 3 ladder transitions to validate no amplification and that rollback completes <2m.
sam (sales): I'll collect top 8 customers that must be excluded or given special terms. Also will draft the customer notification copy.
mia (product): Next steps: jules+evan write API spec (EOD), tera to add staging test plan, ops-oncall draft runbook, sam collect customers & copy, legal will review templates. Sync 11am tomorrow. :thumbsup:
